#include<bits/stdc++.h>

#define ll long long
#define pb push_back
#define pp pop_back
#define fr freopen
#define fi first
#define se second
using namespace std;
ll i , j , k , m , n , c[3000] , d , e , l = 1 , r;
string a , b;
int main()
{
    freopen("gcm.in" , "r" , stdin);
    freopen("gcm.out" , "w" , stdout);
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0); cin.tie(NULL); cout.tie(NULL);
    cin>>a;
    n = a.length();
    b = b + a[0];
    for(i = 1 ; i < n ; i ++)
    {
        if(i < n - 2 && a[i] == 'a' && a[i + 1] == 't' && l == 1)
            b = b + '@' , i ++ , l = 0;
        else if(i < n - 3 && a[i] == 'd' && a[i + 1] == 'o' && a[i + 2] == 't')
            b = b + '.' , i += 2;
        else
            b = b + a[i];
    }
    cout<<b;
    return 0;
}
